newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti firm in Milan but Cofide slumps.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti firm in Milan but Cofide slumps.

text.p: Olivetti shares continued their strong rally in active trade on the Milan stock exchange but Carlo De Benedetti's financial holding Cofide slumped.

Market attention was still focused on developments over the sale of the troubled high-tech group's PC business, traders said, but Cofide, suspended limit down at one point, was floundering after strong buying seen on Thursday.
"After Cofide's rise yesterday the buyers have disappeared and we are seeing very short-term speculative selling," one dealer said.

At 1503 GMT, Olivetti was 3.94 percent up at 559 lire after a high of 572 in volume of over 56 million shares. Cofide was 9.0 percent off at 726 lire after a low at 720 in volume of 5.75 million shares.
